subject: Television & Streaming
title: Walter White: From Teacher to Kingpin
description: One-minute skill: Walter White: From Teacher to Kingpin.

hook.text: A high school chemistry teacher gets a cancer diagnosis and starts cooking methamphetamine.

buildup.text: Walt started sympathetic—a man beaten down by life, finally seizing control.

discovery.text: Bryan Cranston's performance was so nuanced that viewers debated exactly when Walt became irredeemable.

twist.text: When Walt finally admitted 'I did it for me.

climax.text: Walter White showed that the antihero's power lies in making the audience complicit.

punchline.text: A chemistry teacher became the villain we couldn't stop rooting for.

quiz.question: What made Walter White's character arc uniquely effective?
options: His gradual transformation kept viewers complicit, rooting for him long after he became irredeemable
